description: This file provides TypeScript declaration modules, classes, and types for the Microsoft Teams SDK, intended for type checking and IDE tooling support within a TypeScript project.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams application with methods to retrieve bot and app graph tokens.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Handles communication with Microsoft Teams API, including conversation activities.

classes.name: JwtValidator
classes.description: Performs JWT validation with configurable options.

methods.name: getBotToken
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to the bot token as a string or null.

methods.name: getAppGraphToken
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to the app graph token as a string or null.

methods.name: constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string }); constructor
methods.description: Initializes instances of App, Client, and JwtValidator with specified options.

methods.name: conversations.activities
methods.description: Accesses activities within a specific conversation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new activity in a conversation.

methods.name: validateAccessToken
methods.description: Validates a given access token, optionally checking the service URL.

methods.name: createServiceTokenValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator function for service tokens using app ID and optional tenant ID.

ctags.name: constructor
ctags.pattern: /^    constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string });$/
